integrity: Analysis, proof and included code are self-contained; general Poisson-cluster calculus and existing pairwise covariance are credited.
scientific_limitations: Order j >= 3 with finite positive burst factorial moment; independent Brownian trajectories with exponential death, point source, stationary regime, no interactions. Factorial cumulant, not pointwise ordinary cumulant. Finite diagnostics do not prove asymptotics; independent publication priority remains unverified.
title: A universal square-root transverse correlation ridge for burst-born mortal Brownian particles
